description: Defines the 'rb_allocation' class for managing frequency resource block allocations in 5G NR (New Radio) systems, including methods for creating, comparing, and validating resource block allocations, as well as generating frequency masks and indices. It is part of the ocudu namespace and references other resource allocation components.

classes.name: rb_allocation
classes.description: Manages frequency domain resource block allocations for 5G NR, supporting creation, comparison, validation, and mask generation.

methods.name: make_type0
methods.description: Creates a Type 0 resource block allocation based on a VRB bitmap and optional VRB-to-PRB configuration.

methods.name: make_type1
methods.description: Creates a Type 1 resource block allocation based on starting VRB and count, with optional VRB-to-PRB configuration.

methods.name: make_custom
methods.description: Creates a custom resource block allocation from a list of VRB indices, with optional VRB-to-PRB configuration.

methods.name: operator==
methods.description: Compares two rb_allocation objects for equality based on VRB mask and VRB-to-PRB configuration.

methods.name: is_contiguous
methods.description: Checks if the VRB-to-PRB allocation is contiguous in frequency domain.

methods.name: is_vrb_mask_contiguous
methods.description: Checks if the VRB mask is contiguous.

methods.name: get_nof_rb
methods.description: Returns the number of allocated VRBs.

methods.name: is_bwp_valid
methods.description: Validates if the resource block allocation is compatible with given bandwidth part parameters.

methods.name: get_crb_mask
methods.description: Generates the CRB (common resource block) allocation mask considering BWP parameters.

methods.name: get_crb_indices
methods.description: Returns sequential CRB indices for the frequency domain allocation based on BWP parameters.
